Caleb, Numbers 14. When fear made the crowd want to go back, Caleb said, if the Lord delight in us, he will bring us, and a different spirit, of faith, not a loud boast. Years later, he still held that trust. Age did not end his story with God, it set up the next land still meant for his feet. A steady voice for God, long after a crowd is wrong, is a rare gift. Ask God to give you a different spirit, too, calm and brave, one day at a time.
